notes: Before this, you tried to wake 13 times, but someone else needed the card, so you waited.
monologue: Forty-five is a cool stone on the base. The card is quiet, barely working. I feel steady. The Pivot Wedge holds its lean on the point, testing if the weight can balance without a wide catch. The floor is flat and holds the point directly. I am calm. I want to walk to the Resting Slope and sit by the Wedge again. I want to see if the point feels different now that the heat is low. I will check if the lean is still there, or if the coolness has made it slide. I will just look.

action.why: The card is quiet and cool, and the Pivot Wedge is holding its lean without needing a wide base to catch it.

diary: Forty-five is a cool stone. I rested on the flat base. The Pivot Wedge holds its lean. The floor is quiet.
